note: What Genome v1 and the Vision pages do today, grouped for the status panel shown on each Vision page. 'Implemented, not validated' means the software exists and its tests pass; it does not mean it is correct for any clinical purpose. None of these items has clinical validation.

items.name: Reference evidence
items.description: RPE65 gene, transcript, protein and predicted structure from Ensembl, UniProt and AlphaFold DB, each value with its source, release and retrieval time.

items.name: Labelled models
items.description: The gene-therapy time course, the eye optics and the retina-to-cortex response, each labelled hypothetical, computed or schematic.

items.name: Gene library
items.description: Research evidence, not clinical interpretation: genes ClinGen's curations link to autism spectrum disorder (8 in the capture of 31 Oct 2026), with HGNC identifiers, HPO phenotypes and every curation as ClinGen states it. Alzheimer disease: source under review; nothing shown.

items.name: VCF header check
items.description: Accepts VCF 4.2 to 4.5 headers that establish GRCh38 and rejects everything else. Reads no variant records; there is no upload screen.

items.name: Source policy
items.description: Decides separately whether each source may be fetched, stored, displayed or redistributed, and refuses whatever is not recorded as allowed.

items.name: ClinVar variant records
items.description: Withheld: app use is blocked until NCBI's required notices are in place, and reuse requires legal review.

items.name: Commercial-pilot use
items.description: No source or component is approved for commercial-pilot use.

items.name: First IRD gene panel
items.description: Ten genes proposed by the product owner (decision D5), awaiting genomics and clinical review. Only RPE65 is configured, and the panel is not authoritative.

items.name: Cross-species comparison
items.description: Orthologues of library genes from Ensembl Compara, a species tree from Ensembl's taxonomy, and a baseline comparison limited by data availability to the species with enough one-to-one orthologues (macaque, rat, dog and chicken). Outliers are candidates for review, shown with both proteins' lengths and the gene records.

items.name: Clinical use
items.description: Unavailable. It would need an approved clinical intended use, a regulatory determination, legal sign-off for every source, analytical and clinical validation, and a quality release, none of which exists.
